description: This file provides utility functions for handling custom FileNode elements within the lexical editor framework, including conversion from DOM nodes and type checking.

classes.name: FileNode
classes.description: Custom node class representing a file element within the lexical editor

methods.name: convertToFileElement
methods.description: Converts a DOM element into a FileNode if it contains a valid file UUID.

methods.name: $createFileNode
methods.description: Creates a new FileNode instance with the specified UUID.

methods.name: $isFileNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a given node is a FileNode.
